subject: kv request: configurable KV Timeout (#45601)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent across sysvar + optimizer hint parsing, stmtctx/session propagation, point/batch-get snapshot path, and coprocessor request path. Default value 0 preserves prior TiKV RPC timeout behavior; when configured (>0), the value is applied to KVSnapshot (Get/BatchGet) and cop requests (SendReqCtx timeout) with retry/fallback paths returning to defaults. Upstream master later reworked this feature (commit 42723fa9e3, PR #46714) by renaming the sysvar and removing the statement hint.
